plan.notes: Official Gavilan College Program Pathways Mapper (gavilan.programmapper.com), site-content year 2025-2026; pathway “to Certificate - CP-Guidance: Peer Education Leadership-Basic”. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total credits (4) = sum of published pathway slots. Per-course prerequisites are not published in structured form on the mapper, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. A prerequisite naming a course outside the published pathway would be listed in external_prereqs, never invented into a term.

courses.choice_note: Choose one course per the official map's “Choose a course” requirement. The mapper's official choice record lists no structured options; see the official map description and catalog. Map description: Tutoring Writers/Tutoring Technique/Peer Mentoring, 1 unit
